lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are organized into approximately four primary horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, extending from the gill region to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a visible grid-like arrangement of high-intensity nodes across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with specular highlights on the dorsal edge and shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct elongated object, consistent with a commensal remora, is attached to the ventral-lateral region posterior to the right pectoral fin.
